test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The school is holding online activity classes for children.

options.text: Online activity classes for children were held by the school.
Online activity classes for children are being held by the school.
Online school for children is being held by the activity classes.
Online activity classes for children have been held by the school.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Online activity classes for children are being held by the school.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**The given sentence is in **the present continuous tense **due to the **usage of [is + verb 1st form + ing = 'is holding']**

__
 
• When we **convert the present continuous tense in passive voice, **we generally use **[Object + is/am/are + being + verb 3rd form + by + subject]**
 
• **The object is - 'online activity classes'.**
 
• **and the subject is - 'the school'.**
 
• So now the sentence would be - ***Online activity classes for children are being held by the school.***

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the concept with some more examples.

 
• Teachers are distributing the sweets. -*** The sweets are being distributing by teachers.***
 
• My mother is cooking food. - ***Food is being cooked by my mother.***
